counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 初始化层级化知识库文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中建立结构化的知识库
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set up a structured knowledge base in your project

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 接到“/init-deep”指令会扫描项目结构、分析代码依赖,按复杂度给目录打分,在根目录和复杂度高的子目录生成分层的 AGENTS.md 项目说明文档,默认最多深入 3 层。
howto.when: 当你说出“/init-deep”时触发;加“--create-new”会先读旧文档再全部删除重建,加“--max-depth=2”可限制扫描深度(默认 3)。

say.text: 帮我运行 /init-deep,生成分层的 AGENTS.md 文档。
say.note: Claude 会先扫描项目结构,再按复杂度写文档。

say.text: 用 /init-deep --create-new 清空旧文档后整体重建。
say.note: 会先读旧内容,再全部删除并重新生成。
扫描深度限制为两层,生成的文档更少。

howto.what_en: Once installed, on /init-deep Claude scans structure and code dependencies, scores directories by complexity, and writes tiered AGENTS.md files at the root and complex subdirs. Default depth: 3.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user runs /init-deep. Append --create-new to read existing files, delete them all, and regenerate from scratch; --max-depth=N limits scan depth (default 3).

say_en.text: Help me run /init-deep to generate tiered AGENTS.md docs for the project.
say_en.note: Scans the project first, then writes docs by complexity.

say_en.text: Use /init-deep --create-new to delete old docs and rebuild everything.
say_en.note: Reads existing docs first, then deletes and regenerates.

say_en.text: Run /init-deep --max-depth=2 to scan only two directory levels.
say_en.note: Fewer docs are generated, covering two levels.
